hook: Lee moved from speech-recognition research at Apple and Microsoft to running Google's China operation, then built Sinovation Ventures into one of China's most active AI-focused venture firms before founding 01.AI to build large language models for the Chinese market.
name: Kai-Fu Lee

quote.text: AI is serendipity. It is here to liberate us from routine jobs, and it is here to remind us what it is that makes us human.
quote.context: Kai-Fu Lee, TED2018 talk, How AI Can Save Our Humanity, April 2018

moniker: Founder and CEO of 01.AI, Chairman and CEO of Sinovation Ventures

primary.name: Chairman and CEO, Sinovation Ventures official team page
How AI Can Save Our Humanity, TED2018 talk transcript

timeline.event: Works as a principal research scientist at Apple

timeline.impact: Lab is later renamed Microsoft Research Asia
Leads Google's operations in the Chinese market

timeline.event: Leaves Google and founds Innovation Works, later renamed Sinovation Ventures
timeline.impact: Builds a venture capital firm focused on Chinese technology startups

timeline.event: Publishes AI Superpowers: China, Silicon Valley, and the New World Order
timeline.impact: Book becomes a widely read reference on the US-China AI competition
Enters large language model development with the Yi model family

quick_facts: Founder and CEO of 01.AI, an AI startup building large language models, founded in 2023
Chairman and CEO of Sinovation Ventures, a venture capital firm he founded in 2009 as Innovation Works
Served as President of Google China from 2005 to 2009
Founded Microsoft Research China, later renamed Microsoft Research Asia, in 1998
Author of the New York Times bestseller AI Superpowers: China, Silicon Valley, and the New World Order (2018) and co-author of AI 2041 (2021)
Holds a bachelor's degree in computer science from Columbia University and a Ph.D. from Carnegie Mellon University

achievements.title: Founding Microsoft Research China (1998)
achievements.impact: Established what became Microsoft Research Asia, a major computer science research lab in China.

achievements.title: President, Google China (2005-2009)
achievements.impact: Led Google's operations in China during the company's most active period competing in the Chinese search market.

achievements.title: Founding Sinovation Ventures (2009)
achievements.impact: Built a venture capital firm managing dual-currency funds that invested in and advised multiple AI-focused startups in China.

achievements.title: AI Superpowers (2018)
achievements.impact: Wrote a New York Times bestseller comparing the US and Chinese AI ecosystems, widely cited in AI policy discussion.

achievements.title: Founding 01.AI (2023)
achievements.impact: Founded an AI company developing the Yi family of large language models for the Chinese market.
